Research Progress of Transporter⁃Mediated Drug⁃Drug Interaction Studies in New Drug Development
FU Shujun1，XIA Bin2，SI Luqin2，HUANG Jiangeng2（1．Center for Drug Evaluation， National Medical ProductsAdministration， Beijing 100163， China； 2．School of Pharmacy， Tongji Medical College， Huazhong Universityof Science and Technology， Wuhan 430030， China）ABSTRACT There are a large number of drug transporters widely distributed in various tissues and organs in the human body． They are involved in the membrane transport of numerous endogenous substances， toxins， and drugs． The transmembrane transport mediated by transporters not only plays an important role in maintaining the homeostasis of the internal environment， but also closely related to drug absorption， distribution， metabolism， and excretion processes． In clinical practice， drug⁃drug and drug⁃endogenous molecule interactions based on drug transporters may affect therapeutic efficacy or lead to toxic side effects． Therefore， it is particularly important to closely monitor and evaluate the risks of transporters mediated drug⁃drug interactions in the drug development and marketing process． This review summarized the classification， functions， tissue distribution and substrate specificity of typical drug transporters in new drug development． Subsequently， the research progress regarding drugdrug interactions involving 24 drug transporters for 55 newly approved drugs by the US Food and Drug Administration in 2023 is comprehensively reviewed． The aim is to provide reference for further drug⁃drug interaction research together with its scientific significance during new drug development stage．药物转运体根据基因编码分为结合盒binding cassette ， ABC ） 和溶质载体 （ solute ⁃ linked carrier，SLC）两个超家族［1］ ，介导内源性分子、药物及毒素等底物的跨膜转运［2］ 药物转运体表达在肝脏大脑小肠和肾脏等组织在药物吸收分布代谢与排泄中发挥重要作用［3］ 众多研究表明转运体活性改变是药物药物相互作用发生的重要原因促变药可通过改变受变药的药物动力学（pharmacokinetics，PK） 或药效动力学，引起不良反应或影响药物疗效［4］ 因此评估转运体介导的风险对于临床安全与合理用药非常重要目前也是新药成药性评价的重要研究内容［5］。 作者在介绍药物转运体分类功能组织分布底物特异性等特点基础上，进一步对美国食品药品管理局（Food and Drug Administration，FDA）2023 年批准上市的 55 个新药公布的说明书及审评资料中基于药物转运体的药物动力学研究结果探讨转运体介导的研究在新药研发中的应用与意义为国内新药研发提供研究思路与方法
